{"query":"SELECT
  url,
  title,
  SEM_EXTRACT(
    content,
    'a current cafe location in Seattle or Bellevue, Washington',

FROM WEB_SEARCH(
  'site:espressovivace.com Seattle locations hours Capitol Hill',
  'site:milsteadandco.com Seattle location hours coffee',
  'site:elmcoffeeroasters.com Seattle cafe hours Pioneer Square',
  'site:ghostnotecoffee.com Seattle hours menu',

  'site:anchorheadcoffee.com Seattle locations hours',
  'site:victrolacoffee.com Seattle locations hours',
  'site:analogcoffee.com Seattle hours Capitol Hill'

  content,
  'official business page stating the location, hours, menu, or coffee approach of a Seattle or Bellevue cafe'

function.arguments:
{"query":"WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    url,
    title,
    cafe,
    address,
    hours,
    signature AS coffee_detail,
    status_note
  FROM r21aee076422
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    url,
    title,
    info.cafe AS cafe,
    info.address AS address,
    info.hours AS hours,
    info.coffee_focus AS coffee_detail,
    NULL AS status_note
  FROM ra4539b4aed2
), tagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%elm coffee%' THEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters'
      WHEN lower(title) LIKE '%olympia coffee downtown seattle%' THEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%fulcrum%' THEN 'Fulcrum Coffee Café'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%victrola%' THEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%ghost note%' THEN 'Ghost Note Coffee'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%espresso vivace%'
        AND lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) NOT LIKE '%alley 24%' THEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%bellden%' THEN 'Bellden Café'
      WHEN (lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%cafe hagen%'
        OR lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%café hagen%')
        AND lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%bellevue%' THEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue'
      WHEN lower(COALESCE(cafe, '') || ' ' || title) LIKE '%third culture%' THEN 'Third Culture Coffee'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS stop,
    CASE
      WHEN url LIKE '%elmcoffeeroasters.com%' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://olympiacoffee.com/pages/downtown-seattle' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://fulcrumcoffee.com/visit-us' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://victrolacoffee.com/blogs/events' THEN 20
      WHEN url LIKE '%ghostnotecoffee.com%' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://espressovivace.com/retail/brix' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://belldencafe.com' THEN 20
      WHEN title = 'Bellevue | Cafe Hagen' THEN 20
      WHEN url = 'https://thirdculturecoffee.com/visit' THEN 20
      WHEN url LIKE '%olympiacoffee.com%' OR url LIKE '%fulcrumcoffee.com%'
        OR url LIKE '%victrolacoffee.com%' OR url LIKE '%espressovivace.com%'
        OR url LIKE '%belldencafe.com%' OR url LIKE '%cafehagen.com%'
        OR url LIKE '%thirdculturecoffee.com%' THEN 10
      ELSE 1
    END
    + CASE WHEN hours IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END
    + CASE WHEN coffee_detail IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS source_score
  FROM candidates
), one_per_stop AS (
  SELECT
    stop,
    ARG_MAX(url, source_score) AS source_url,
    ARG_MAX(hours, CASE WHEN hours IS NOT NULL THEN source_score ELSE -1 END) AS sourced_hours,
    ARG_MAX(address, CASE WHEN address IS NOT NULL THEN source_score ELSE -1 END) AS sourced_address
  FROM tagged
  WHERE stop IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY stop
), itinerary AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN stop IN (
      'Elm Coffee Roasters',
      'Olympia Coffee — Downtown',
      'Victrola Roastery & Café',
      'Ghost Note Coffee',
      'Espresso Vivace — Brix'
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS day,
    CASE stop
      WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown' THEN 2
      WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN 3
      WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN 4
      WHEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix' THEN 5
      WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue' THEN 2
      WHEN 'Third Culture Coffee' THEN 3
    END AS stop_order,
    CASE stop
      WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN '08:00'
      WHEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown' THEN '09:15'
      WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN '11:00'
      WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN '12:30'
      WHEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix' THEN '14:00'
      WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN '08:00'
      WHEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue' THEN '09:30'
      WHEN 'Third Culture Coffee' THEN '11:00'
    END AS suggested_time,
    CASE stop
      WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN 'Pioneer Square, Seattle'
      WHEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown' THEN 'Downtown Seattle'
      WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN 'Capitol Hill, Seattle'
      WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN 'Capitol Hill, Seattle'
      WHEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix' THEN 'Capitol Hill, Seattle'
      WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN 'Old Bellevue / Main Street'
      WHEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue' THEN 'Downtown Bellevue'
      WHEN 'Third Culture Coffee' THEN 'Downtown Bellevue'
    END AS area,
    stop,
    CASE stop
      WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN 'Begin with an espresso-and-filter comparison; ask whether the One & One or One of Everything flight is available.'
      WHEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown' THEN 'Taste a seasonal single-origin as filter or espresso and compare extraction with Elm.'
      WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN 'Anchor the day around the listed Wednesday 11am public cupping; verify it is running before travel.'
      WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN 'Switch from classic tasting to a creative seasonal signature; share one drink to control caffeine.'
      WHEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix' THEN 'Finish Seattle with a straight espresso or small milk drink focused on texture and traditional espresso craft.'
      WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN 'Start Bellevue with its deliberate pour-over program; optionally share the Rosemary Burnt Honey Latte.'
      WHEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue' THEN 'Pair Scandinavian-influenced coffee, roasted by Hagen, with a house pastry or brunch item.'
      WHEN 'Third Culture Coffee' THEN 'Finish with a globally inspired preparation such as Indian filter, Vietnamese, or New Orleans coffee.'
    END AS tasting_plan,
    CASE stop
      WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN 'Walk toward downtown'
      WHEN 'Olympia Coffee — Downtown' THEN 'Light rail to Capitol Hill'
      WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN 'Walk'
      WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN 'Walk'
      WHEN 'Espresso Vivace — Brix' THEN 'End of day'
      WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN 'Walk or short ride'
      WHEN 'Café Hagen — Bellevue' THEN 'Walk or short ride'
      WHEN 'Third Culture Coffee' THEN 'End of tour'
    END AS next_leg,
    COALESCE(
      sourced_hours,
      CASE stop
        WHEN 'Elm Coffee Roasters' THEN 'Verify before visiting'
        WHEN 'Victrola Roastery & Café' THEN 'Public cupping listed Wed 11am; verify current schedule'
        WHEN 'Ghost Note Coffee' THEN 'Verify before visiting'
        WHEN 'Bellden Café' THEN 'Official site says open daily; verify exact hours'
        ELSE 'Verify before visiting'
      END
    ) AS planning_hours,
    sourced_address AS address_if_stated,
    source_url
  FROM one_per_stop
)
SELECT
  *,
  COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_stops,
  COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY day) AS stops_that_day
FROM itinerary
ORDER BY day, stop_order","show_preview":false}
